text:
leah: Morning team — quick Aurelia Labs weekly spot. Billing-bot flagged a hosted API spend surge yesterday that pushed them above their $6k/mo committed tier. Can we triage root cause before EOD?

omar: On it. Do we have the daily breakdown and which routes spiked?

billing-bot: [ALERT] Aurelia Labs (acct: aurelia-labs) — hosted API spend +210% (3d) vs baseline. Top callers: /generate (75%), /embeddings (18%). Top time window: 2026-03-16 02:00-06:00 UTC.

jess: Account is on a $6k/mo commit (monthly). Last commit check was 2026-02-01. Overages bill monthly. Notified finance last week about a possible delta but this is larger.

sam: Also seeing a concurrent increase in token latency for /generate during that window — p95 up from 220ms to 540ms. Might be retry storms causing duplicated tokens?

mike: Noted a release from Aurelia on 2026-03-15 — they switched to streaming for a bulk export job. Could be misconfigured client loop causing repeated calls. I can check logs if you want the sample traces.

leah: Yes please Mike — if streaming loop misfires that's a common source. If it's the export job, outreach to the engineer for rate-limiting guidance (and suggest batching/caching).

mike: Sample rate-limited trace snippet from our traces index: 
```
2026-03-16T02:14:02Z aurelia-labs /generate id=abc123 attempts=1 tokens_sent=1200 duration_ms=512
2026-03-16T02:14:07Z aurelia-labs /generate id=abc124 attempts=1 tokens_sent=1188 duration_ms=538
2026-03-16T02:14:09Z aurelia-labs /generate id=abc125 attempts=4 tokens_sent=1200 duration_ms=1620 (retries)
```

ana: (typo: ana) I'm on a call but can drop a note to their dev lead and ask for the job config + any recent rollout details. Should I include our suggested batching doc?

leah: Yes include batching + recommended streaming client pattern. Also add a suggested temporary throttling policy in Redwood Console (route-level cap) so they don't burn commit while we triage.

jess: I'll flag billing: request a temporary cap and ask finance if we can apply a one-time credit while we investigate.

omar: Quick numbers snapshot from our billing ingestion (daily spend USD):
```
2026-03-13: 180
2026-03-14: 210
2026-03-15: 250
2026-03-16: 760  <-- spike
2026-03-17: 420
```

sam: Error rate for /generate also increased around the spike (500s from client-side timeouts). Might be client retries inflating tokens.

mike: Actionable: I can pull full trace set + example request bodies. If we see identical bodies repeated, we can confirm client loop.

ana: I'll message Aurelia dev lead @marco and ask for their release notes and whether they enabled streaming export on 03/15.

leah: TL;DR and next steps: 1) Mike pull traces + check duplicated request bodies (owner: mike) 2) Ana contact Aurelia devs + share batching doc (owner: ana) 3) Jess request temporary route cap and finance review (owner: jess) 4) Sam monitor latency and error rate; set alert to auto-close when p95 under 300ms for 4h (owner: sam) 5) Leah to coordinate customer comms and propose one-time credit if root-cause client-side.

omar: Adding: If root cause is server-side (our regressions), we prep rollback/patch and notify legal/finance.

billing-bot: [NOTE] Temporary route cap suggestion posted to console for Aurelia Labs: /generate set to 6 rps burst 12. (pending approval)

leah: Great. Can everyone update the thread with status by EOD. Thanks :thumbsup:

mike: Will update after trace review (ETA 2h).

ana: Pinged Aurelia devs and awaiting reply.

jess: Finance accepts review; will confirm by 5pm PT if credit OK.

sam: Monitoring rule in place, will post if p95 drops.

leah: Perfect — I'll prepare a short customer note summarizing findings once we have trace confirmation.

(ends)
